serviceCapacity.source: allocatedMin from flexcar.service_capacities; bookedMin from each bucket's own table (capacity_bookings source_type='Order', maintenance_bookings, unassigned_services); ledgerBookedMin from service_capacities reserved columns.
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes set aside for the bucket; bookedMin is the authoritative booked figure from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved column, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible -- never use it as the booked side. onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy. null means no service_capacities row for that site/day, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until someone edits the lot. daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling. null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero. Unrelated to the service-minute allocation in serviceCapacity.
